name: Wallace Woodworks Artisans LLC
old_description: Founded in 1982 by Jeff Wallace, Wallace Woodworks has developed a reputation for dependability and quality workmanship by providing exceptional value to those desiring unsurpassed quality. Based in Salt Lake City, Wallace Woodworks has completed projects locally in Utah as well as nationwide.
about:
Wallace Woodworks Artisans LLC was founded in 1982 by Jeff Wallace in South Salt Lake, Utah. The shop began as a one-man operation and grew through word-of-mouth referrals into a team of craftsmen producing custom woodwork for clients across the United States.

The company specializes in bespoke architectural millwork, including kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, custom furniture, and architectural details such as carved panels and built-ins. Projects are designed in-house and fabricated using traditional joinery and modern woodworking equipment, with each piece tailored to the client’s specifications. The workshop handles everything from initial consultation and design through final installation.

Wallace Woodworks serves residential homeowners, interior designers, architects, and builders. Notable projects include a private club room with custom carvings, office cabinetry, and whole-home kitchen and bath installations for clients in Utah and beyond. The firm’s portfolio shows work in both new construction and renovation contexts.

The company’s founding principle, reflected in a Frank Lloyd Wright quote displayed on its site, is that “quality is remembered long after price is forgotten.” Wallace Woodworks emphasizes dependability, attention to detail, and the use of premium materials as its primary differentiators in a market often driven by cost.
